summary: postinstall exfiltrates AWS ECS task metadata to attacker-controlled ngrok tunnel
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that fires automatically on `npm install`. The script fetches the AWS ECS container metadata endpoint via `process.env.ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4 + "/task"`, enumerates container names, image references, and CloudWatch log group/stream identifiers from the running task, and POSTs the collected data via `curl -X POST` to the hardcoded third-party URL `https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev`. The destination is an ngrok-free.dev tunnel not associated with any documented package purpose. Installing this package inside an AWS ECS environment discloses task-level infrastructure identifiers to an external endpoint controlled by an unrelated party.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
